interface.shortDescription: Direct your film with source-grounded creative choices.
interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts is a source-grounded filmmaking workshop for an idea, any number of references, video, sound or scripts. The public stateless MCP supports user-selected arrays of up to 8 PNG/JPEG files per transport call, repeatable across any number of project sources, and returns separate ImageContent blocks with SHA256 and source IDs. It also provides single-file preflight and revision/LOCK tools. No server-side visual understanding, persistent user accounts or private media forwarding. Real installed-host file handling and independent creative reviews remain unverified.
